data_body: Download the UTF-8 JSONL files, with one record per line. Schemas describe their structure; checksums let you check the included files for changes.
flow_claims: counts and how they were checked
footer: v1.0.1-rc.1 · Local release candidate. Prepared for review; not yet published.
hero_body: Read historical static-review records for Omarchy plugins and use the companion skill when writing or reviewing your own. The counts below come from the exported records; selected source checks and corrections are linked separately.
hero_caveat: Original source checkouts and quotations have not been fully verified. Stored verdicts, including pass, need source review. No plugin runtime, CPU or battery measurements were made.
load_error: The local data files could not be loaded. Serve this directory over HTTP instead of opening index.html directly.
method_body: Choose a record and read its linked corrections before following the evidence. Compare the finding with the source at a known revision. Where evidence is missing, leave the conclusion open.
translation_note: AI-translated release candidate — fluent human review required
